draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.27, the 55th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 8th of 37 at CB. He lasted until pick 85, well after his grade rank (55th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Dante Hall (as return talent). Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2021) ranked 3rd in passes defended among the 31 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the New England Patriots. 48 career games and 22 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (13 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: approximate value 13 (99th percentile), interceptions 3 (92nd percentile), passes defended 11 (85th percentile). Weak spots: completion % allowed 68.0% (24th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 cornerback who played: 70.8% season snap share against a median of 34.8%, above the norm.
